WAR OF THE REBELLION (fixture text for tools/tests/test_prior_work.py; not a real volume)
FORT MONROE, VA., April 21, 1864-12 p.m.
Hon. G. V. FOX, Assistant Secretary of the Navy:
The torpedo boat is ready and the camels are at Norfolk. BENJ. F. BUTLER, Major-General.

WASHINGTON, April 23, 1864.
Major-General AUGUR:
The cavalry at Warrenton Junction will move at daylight with 350 men toward Bealeton Station.
H. W. HALLECK, Major-General, Chief of Staff.

HEADQUARTERS, March 2, 1864.
General MEADE: nothing to report. U. S. GRANT.
